{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == '999,999.99'
qa_orders_mask = data['revenue'] == '999,999.99'

# Remove QA orders from the dataset
filtered_data = data[~qa_orders_mask].copy()

# Now, filter for converted customers and non-missing age
converters = filtered_data[filtered_data['converted'] == 1]
valid_age_converters = converters[converters['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of converters with valid age
mean_age = valid_age_converters['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Number of converted customers (after removing QA orders): {len(valid_age_converters)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (valid age, no QA orders): {mean_age:.2f}")"}
